title: 混凝土面板堆石壩施工~Concrete-face rockfill dam construction
focus: 堆石變形、混凝土面板與周邊接縫的相容~Compatibility of rockfill deformation, concrete facing and perimeter joints
summary: 本課以混凝土面板堆石壩施工為入口，深入堆石變形、混凝土面板與周邊接縫的相容。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Concrete-face rockfill dam construction as its entry point, this course examines compatibility of rockfill deformation, concrete facing and perimeter joints. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 密度敏感度固定顆粒密度2700 kg/m³，只將乾密度由2100提高到2200 kg/m³。n=1−ρd/ρs由0.2222降至0.1852，即孔隙率約由22.22%降至18.52%。這是相同顆粒密度下的體積比例比較，仍忽略顆粒內孔隙及含水修正誤差；單由孔隙率下降不能推定壓縮模數或滲透係數變化量。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002. Total compression is 0.19 m, a one-dimensional layered approximation. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold particle density at 2700 kg/m³ and change only dry density from 2100 to 2200 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs falls from 0.2222 to 0.1852, approximately 22.22% to 18.52%. This volume-ratio comparison still excludes intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error; the porosity change alone does not determine changes in compressibility or permeability.
history: 混凝土面板堆石壩把防滲和承載功能交給不同材料，面板、墊層、堆石與趾板必須在變形後仍保持相容與連續。反濾層標準章節更新，聚焦顆粒保持與區域界面。 土石壩設計與施工章節更新，連結材料、填築與品質控制。 滲流與監測章節更新，提供服役水壓及行為判讀背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。~Concrete-face rockfill dams assign sealing and support to different materials. Facing, cushion, rockfill and plinth must remain compatible and continuous after deformation. The protective-filter standard is updated, emphasizing particle retention and zone interfaces. Embankment design and construction chapters are updated to connect materials, placement and quality control. Seepage and monitoring chapters are updated, supporting interpretation of service pressures and behavior. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

units.anchor: 堆石孔隙與密實~Rockfill voids and density
units.title: 堆石孔隙與密實~Rockfill voids and density
units.mechanism: 堆石透過顆粒重排和局部破碎變密，現場乾密度反映總孔隙但不直接給出壓縮模數。顆粒尺寸遠大於一般試體時，尺寸效應必須獨立處理。 假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。~Rockfill densifies by particle rearrangement and breakage. Dry density indicates bulk voids but does not directly give compressibility, and particles larger than normal specimens require separate treatment of scale effects. Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error. Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error.
units.verify: 在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。比較濕化前後的壓縮試驗以檢查密度代表性。~Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines. Compare compression before and after wetting to test density representativeness.
units.failure: 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。~Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects.
units.misconception: 堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。~Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.
units.practice: 以堆石孔隙與密實編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rockfill voids and density, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines.

units.anchor: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降~Layer compression and crest settlement
units.title: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降~Layer compression and crest settlement
units.mechanism: 堆石壩沉降是不同高程層壓縮的累積，局部大應變不一定出現在壩頂。分層量測能辨認填築、蓄水與長期作用各自造成的位移。 假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。 只看壩頂總沉降可能把某一薄層的大應變平均掉，面板卻對局部曲率敏感。若基礎基準也沉降，所有相對儀器可能低估絕對位移。~Crest settlement accumulates compression across layers, while the largest local strain need not occur at the crest. Layered measurements distinguish placement, impoundment and long-term contributions to movement. Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002. Total compression is 0.19 m, a one-dimensional layered approximation. Crest settlement can average out severe strain in a thin layer, while the face responds to local curvature. A settling reference foundation can make relative instruments understate absolute movement throughout the section.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002. Total compression is 0.19 m, a one-dimensional layered approximation.
units.verify: 比較分層沉降計與壩頂測量的閉合，將各層填築完成時間和蓄水歷程對齊；檢查儀器錨點是否移動，並區分地基沉降與壩體自身壓縮。以不同高程錨點差分辨認真正的薄層壓縮。~Close layer-settlement measurements against crest surveying and align completion dates with reservoir history. Check anchor movement and separate foundation settlement from compression within the embankment itself. Difference anchors at several elevations to identify compression within thin layers.
units.failure: 只看壩頂總沉降可能把某一薄層的大應變平均掉，面板卻對局部曲率敏感。若基礎基準也沉降，所有相對儀器可能低估絕對位移。~Crest settlement can average out severe strain in a thin layer, while the face responds to local curvature. A settling reference foundation can make relative instruments understate absolute movement throughout the section.
units.misconception: 壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。~Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer.
units.practice: 以分層壓縮與壩頂沉降編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較分層沉降計與壩頂測量的閉合，將各層填築完成時間和蓄水歷程對齊；檢查儀器錨點是否移動，並區分地基沉降與壩體自身壓縮。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for layer compression and crest settlement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Close layer-settlement measurements against crest surveying and align completion dates with reservoir history. Check anchor movement and separate foundation settlement from compression within the embankment itself.

units.anchor: 面板曲率與拉應變~Face curvature and tensile strain
units.title: 面板曲率與拉應變~Face curvature and tensile strain
units.mechanism: 混凝土面板隨堆石支承變形彎曲，曲率比整體平移更直接影響表面拉應變。面板厚度與支承接觸條件共同控制反應，不能只檢查混凝土抗壓強度。 假設面板厚0.4 m、曲率0.001 m⁻¹，中性軸居中且線彈性，表面應變κt/2=0.0002，即200 microstrain；未含膜應變。 支承局部脫空可能使彎曲集中，即使整體沉降平滑仍可裂縫。用過長測距平均曲率會漏掉短波變形，單側應變也難分膜力與彎曲。~Concrete facing bends with its rockfill support, and curvature influences tensile strain more directly than rigid translation. Thickness and support contact govern response, so compressive strength alone is insufficient. Assume face thickness 0.4 m, curvature 0.001 m⁻¹ and centered neutral axis under linear bending. Surface strain κt/2=200 microstrain, excluding membrane strain. Local support loss concentrates bending despite smooth overall settlement. Long gauge spacing averages away short-wavelength curvature, while one-sided strain alone cannot distinguish membrane action from flexural response.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設面板厚0.4 m、曲率0.001 m⁻¹，中性軸居中且線彈性，表面應變κt/2=0.0002，即200 microstrain；未含膜應變。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume face thickness 0.4 m, curvature 0.001 m⁻¹ and centered neutral axis under linear bending. Surface strain κt/2=200 microstrain, excluding membrane strain.
units.verify: 用相鄰測點曲線估算曲率，檢查測距與數值微分對雜訊的敏感性；對照面板兩面應變和裂縫方向，並將剛體位移與局部彎曲分開判讀。以更密測點確認局部曲率不是微分雜訊。~Estimate curvature from neighboring survey points and test sensitivity to spacing and differentiation noise. Compare opposite-face strains and crack direction, distinguishing rigid movement from local bending in the interpretation. Use closer survey spacing to confirm local curvature is not differentiation noise.
units.failure: 支承局部脫空可能使彎曲集中，即使整體沉降平滑仍可裂縫。用過長測距平均曲率會漏掉短波變形，單側應變也難分膜力與彎曲。~Local support loss concentrates bending despite smooth overall settlement. Long gauge spacing averages away short-wavelength curvature, while one-sided strain alone cannot distinguish membrane action from flexural response.
units.misconception: 面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。~High face compressive strength guarantees no tensile cracking from support curvature.
units.practice: 以面板曲率與拉應變編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用相鄰測點曲線估算曲率，檢查測距與數值微分對雜訊的敏感性；對照面板兩面應變和裂縫方向，並將剛體位移與局部彎曲分開判讀。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for face curvature and tensile strain, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Estimate curvature from neighboring survey points and test sensitivity to spacing and differentiation noise. Compare opposite-face strains and crack direction, distinguishing rigid movement from local bending in the interpretation.

units.anchor: 周邊接縫位移分量~Perimeter-joint movement components
units.title: 周邊接縫位移分量~Perimeter-joint movement components
units.mechanism: 面板與趾板交界會發生張開、沉降和剪移，止水需對應三方向變形。單一合位移大小相同，不表示止水受力和漏水風險相同。 假設接縫張開8 mm、沿縫剪移6 mm，平面合位移√(8²+6²)=10 mm；分量仍須保留，不能當成等效容許張開。 法向張開與剪向錯動對銅片或橡膠止水的影響不同，反覆循環也會累積疲勞。若只記錄合位移，可能把危險張開誤當較可容受的滑移。~The face-plinth interface experiences opening, settlement and shear, requiring waterstops to accommodate three components. Equal resultant displacement does not imply equal waterstop loading or leakage risk. Assume opening 8 mm and along-joint shear 6 mm. Planar resultant is 10 mm, but components remain necessary and this is not an equivalent allowable opening. Opening and shear act differently on metal or elastomeric waterstops, and cycles accumulate damage. Recording only a resultant can disguise critical opening as a more tolerable sliding movement.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫張開8 mm、沿縫剪移6 mm，平面合位移√(8²+6²)=10 mm；分量仍須保留，不能當成等效容許張開。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume opening 8 mm and along-joint shear 6 mm. Planar resultant is 10 mm, but components remain necessary and this is not an equivalent allowable opening.
units.verify: 以多方向接縫計保存分量和符號，對照庫位、溫度與堆石沉降；檢查量測軸線是否隨面板轉動，並比較接頭試驗採用的變形路徑而非單一合量。對照止水試驗是否採用了同方向循環路徑。~Retain signed components from multi-axis joint meters and compare reservoir level, temperature and settlement. Check whether measuring axes rotate with the face and compare the tested deformation path rather than one resultant magnitude. Check whether waterstop tests used the same directional cyclic movement path.
units.failure: 法向張開與剪向錯動對銅片或橡膠止水的影響不同，反覆循環也會累積疲勞。若只記錄合位移，可能把危險張開誤當較可容受的滑移。~Opening and shear act differently on metal or elastomeric waterstops, and cycles accumulate damage. Recording only a resultant can disguise critical opening as a more tolerable sliding movement.
units.misconception: 只要接縫合位移相同，止水承受的變形模式就完全相同。~Equal resultant joint displacement means an identical deformation mode for the waterstop.
units.practice: 以周邊接縫位移分量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以多方向接縫計保存分量和符號，對照庫位、溫度與堆石沉降；檢查量測軸線是否隨面板轉動，並比較接頭試驗採用的變形路徑而非單一合量。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for perimeter-joint movement components, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Retain signed components from multi-axis joint meters and compare reservoir level, temperature and settlement. Check whether measuring axes rotate with the face and compare the tested deformation path rather than one resultant magnitude.

units.anchor: 趾板基礎接觸~Plinth foundation contact
units.title: 趾板基礎接觸~Plinth foundation contact
units.mechanism: 趾板把面板防滲系統接到基岩，接觸連續性與基礎水壓共同影響功能。它不是只靠混凝土重量阻水，岩面弱帶和接縫繞流也必須追蹤。 假設趾板接觸面積60 m²、總正力12 MN、上浮3 MN，有效平均壓力(12−3)/60=0.15 MPa；均勻接觸且不含彎矩。 局部岩面凸起會造成接觸集中，弱帶沖蝕則可能形成繞流。若只用總重量除面積判斷完整接觸，會低估上浮和面板傳來偏心力的影響。~The plinth connects the face sealing system to bedrock, with contact continuity and foundation pressure controlling performance. Concrete weight alone does not block seepage through weak seams or bypass joints. Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN. Mean effective pressure is 0.15 MPa, for uniform contact without moment. Rock high points concentrate contact while weak-seam erosion creates bypass flow. Dividing gross weight by area can understate uplift and eccentric actions transferred from the facing, giving a false impression of continuous contact.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設趾板接觸面積60 m²、總正力12 MN、上浮3 MN，有效平均壓力(12−3)/60=0.15 MPa；均勻接觸且不含彎矩。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN. Mean effective pressure is 0.15 MPa, for uniform contact without moment.
units.verify: 查驗岩面清理、地質素描和接觸取芯資料，將孔壓測點對應到弱帶；比較接縫位移與分區滲流，確認平均接觸假設沒有掩蓋局部脫開。將趾板合力位置與實際接觸區域互相核對。~Review cleaned-rock mapping and contact cores and relate pressure points to weak seams. Compare joint movement with zoned seepage to ensure a mean-contact assumption is not concealing local separation along the plinth. Cross-check the plinth resultant location against the actually contacting region.
units.failure: 局部岩面凸起會造成接觸集中，弱帶沖蝕則可能形成繞流。若只用總重量除面積判斷完整接觸，會低估上浮和面板傳來偏心力的影響。~Rock high points concentrate contact while weak-seam erosion creates bypass flow. Dividing gross weight by area can understate uplift and eccentric actions transferred from the facing, giving a false impression of continuous contact.
units.misconception: 趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。~A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture.
units.practice: 以趾板基礎接觸編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。查驗岩面清理、地質素描和接觸取芯資料，將孔壓測點對應到弱帶；比較接縫位移與分區滲流，確認平均接觸假設沒有掩蓋局部脫開。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for plinth foundation contact, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Review cleaned-rock mapping and contact cores and relate pressure points to weak seams. Compare joint movement with zoned seepage to ensure a mean-contact assumption is not concealing local separation along the plinth.

units.title: 墊層反濾相容~Cushion-filter compatibility
units.mechanism: 面板墊層既提供平整支承，也需防止細料向粗堆石遷移。支承剛度和反濾能力是不同要求，級配必須與相鄰材料及施工離析一起檢查。 假設基料d85=0.8 mm、相鄰反濾料D15=2.4 mm，比值3；只是粒徑保持篩選，不取代土類適用性與滲流試驗。 墊層缺口可能同時造成漏流和面板脫空，局部細料流失未必立刻反映在總漏水量。只確認粒徑比合格，仍不能排除施工接頭或厚度不足。~The face cushion supplies even support and prevents fines migrating into coarse rockfill. Support stiffness and filtration are separate requirements, so grading must be checked with adjacent materials and placement segregation. Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three. This screens retention geometry without replacing soil-specific applicability or seepage tests. A cushion gap can create leakage and support loss together, while local fines migration may not immediately change total leakage. Passing one grading ratio does not exclude construction discontinuities or insufficient layer thickness.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基料d85=0.8 mm、相鄰反濾料D15=2.4 mm，比值3；只是粒徑保持篩選，不取代土類適用性與滲流試驗。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three. This screens retention geometry without replacing soil-specific applicability or seepage tests.
units.verify: 從面板下實際鋪設材料取樣，對照料場級配及含泥量；以方向相符的滲流試驗觀察細料流失，並核對支承平整度是否因離析或沖刷而降低。檢查薄層接頭是否造成墊層局部不連續。~Sample placed material beneath the face and compare stockpile grading and fines. Use directionally relevant seepage tests to observe migration and check whether segregation or erosion reduces support uniformity. Inspect whether layer junctions create local discontinuities in the face cushion.
units.failure: 墊層缺口可能同時造成漏流和面板脫空，局部細料流失未必立刻反映在總漏水量。只確認粒徑比合格，仍不能排除施工接頭或厚度不足。~A cushion gap can create leakage and support loss together, while local fines migration may not immediately change total leakage. Passing one grading ratio does not exclude construction discontinuities or insufficient layer thickness.
units.misconception: 反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。~A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity.
units.practice: 以墊層反濾相容編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從面板下實際鋪設材料取樣，對照料場級配及含泥量；以方向相符的滲流試驗觀察細料流失，並核對支承平整度是否因離析或沖刷而降低。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cushion-filter compatibility, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Sample placed material beneath the face and compare stockpile grading and fines. Use directionally relevant seepage tests to observe migration and check whether segregation or erosion reduces support uniformity.

units.anchor: 斜面水壓與合力~Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face
units.title: 斜面水壓與合力~Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face
units.mechanism: 靜水壓垂直作用在面板表面，合力依垂直水深分布而非沿坡距離直接計算。法向力再由堆石支承和趾板系統傳遞，須保留方向。 取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米寬面板斜長50 m、坡角對水平30°，底部垂深25 m，合力γw hL/2=6131.25 kN/m；平面靜水且頂部在水面。 以斜長當水深會高估壓力，忽略法向分量又會誤判支承需求。若面板部分失去接觸，水壓將引起局部彎曲，不能仍假定全部均勻傳入堆石。~Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the face and varies with vertical depth rather than slope distance alone. Rockfill support and plinth transfer the normal resultant, whose direction must be retained. Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume face slope length 50 m per metre width at thirty degrees to horizontal, giving bottom depth 25 m. Resultant γw hL/2=6131.25 kN/m, with the top at the surface. Using slope length as depth overstates pressure, while ignoring direction misstates support demand. Loss of contact causes local bending under water load and invalidates uniformly transferred pressure into the rockfill.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米寬面板斜長50 m、坡角對水平30°，底部垂深25 m，合力γw hL/2=6131.25 kN/m；平面靜水且頂部在水面。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume face slope length 50 m per metre width at thirty degrees to horizontal, giving bottom depth 25 m. Resultant γw hL/2=6131.25 kN/m, with the top at the surface.
units.verify: 將面板測量剖面換成垂直水深，分別積分法向力與對趾部力矩；核對水位基準、實際淹沒範圍和支承反力方向，避免把水平投影與斜面面積混用。以垂直投影獨立核對水壓水平分量大小。~Convert surveyed slope coordinates to vertical depth and integrate normal force and toe moment separately. Check datum, wetted extent and support-reaction directions, keeping horizontal projections distinct from inclined surface area. Independently check the horizontal pressure component using the vertical projection.
units.failure: 以斜長當水深會高估壓力，忽略法向分量又會誤判支承需求。若面板部分失去接觸，水壓將引起局部彎曲，不能仍假定全部均勻傳入堆石。~Using slope length as depth overstates pressure, while ignoring direction misstates support demand. Loss of contact causes local bending under water load and invalidates uniformly transferred pressure into the rockfill.
units.misconception: 斜面上任一點水壓應依沿坡距離而非垂直水深計算。~Pressure at an inclined-face point depends on slope distance rather than vertical depth.
units.practice: 以斜面水壓與合力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將面板測量剖面換成垂直水深，分別積分法向力與對趾部力矩；核對水位基準、實際淹沒範圍和支承反力方向，避免把水平投影與斜面面積混用。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Convert surveyed slope coordinates to vertical depth and integrate normal force and toe moment separately. Check datum, wetted extent and support-reaction directions, keeping horizontal projections distinct from inclined surface area.

units.anchor: 分期蓄水與濕化沉降~Staged filling and wetting settlement
units.title: 分期蓄水與濕化沉降~Staged filling and wetting settlement
units.mechanism: 蓄水會讓堆石受水壓並發生濕化變形，沉降速率可能落後水位。分期觀測的目的在辨認反應，不是用固定等待天數保證所有材料已穩定。 假設教學一階沉降S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ))，S∞=0.1 m、τ=10 days，20 days達86.47 mm；僅擬合模型，非真實材料定律。 材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。若把擬合漸近值當實際最終值，可能低估後續接縫位移。~Impoundment adds water loading and wetting deformation, with settlement potentially lagging stage. Staged observation identifies response rather than guaranteeing stabilization after a universal waiting duration. Assume teaching settlement S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ)), S∞=0.1 m and τ=10 days. At twenty days S=86.47 mm, a fitted model rather than a material law. Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load. Treating a fitted asymptote as a final value can understate later joint displacement.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設教學一階沉降S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ))，S∞=0.1 m、τ=10 days，20 days達86.47 mm；僅擬合模型，非真實材料定律。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume teaching settlement S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ)), S∞=0.1 m and τ=10 days. At twenty days S=86.47 mm, a fitted model rather than a material law.
units.verify: 將水位階段、分層沉降和面板接縫同步作圖，檢查每次階段是否有不同時間常數；用後續資料驗證預測區間，不能只以早期擬合度宣稱趨勢可靠。保留每階段預測與後續實測的差異紀錄。~Plot reservoir stages, layer settlement and face joints together and check whether each stage has a different time constant. Validate prediction intervals on later data rather than relying only on an early fit. Retain a record of each stage prediction and subsequent measured discrepancy.
units.failure: 材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。若把擬合漸近值當實際最終值，可能低估後續接縫位移。~Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load. Treating a fitted asymptote as a final value can understate later joint displacement.
units.misconception: 教學沉降曲線擬合良好就能保證最終沉降不再增加。~A good fit to the teaching settlement curve guarantees no further ultimate settlement.
units.practice: 以分期蓄水與濕化沉降編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將水位階段、分層沉降和面板接縫同步作圖，檢查每次階段是否有不同時間常數；用後續資料驗證預測區間，不能只以早期擬合度宣稱趨勢可靠。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for staged filling and wetting settlement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot reservoir stages, layer settlement and face joints together and check whether each stage has a different time constant. Validate prediction intervals on later data rather than relying only on an early fit.

units.anchor: 漏流與水量閉合~Leakage and water-balance closure
units.title: 漏流與水量閉合~Leakage and water-balance closure
units.mechanism: 漏水量需與庫位、降雨和排水系統一起判讀，總量增減不能單獨定位面板裂縫。分區量測與水質示蹤可區分壩體、基礎和外部集水。 假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。 突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。未校正外部雨水便比較兩次蓄水，會把不同環境條件誤當面板性能改變。~Leakage must be interpreted with reservoir level, rain and drainage. Total change alone cannot locate face cracks; sectional measurement and water-quality tracing distinguish embankment, foundation and external collection. Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Corrected seepage is 85 L/s, with steady additive sources and no storage lag. An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. Comparing impoundments without rainfall correction confuses environmental differences with changes in face performance.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Corrected seepage is 85 L/s, with steady additive sources and no storage lag.
units.verify: 分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。將清通排水管的時間與流量跳變逐項對照。~Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources. Compare joint events with leakage lag and test closure residuals against measurement uncertainty. Compare drain-clearing times individually against observed jumps in measured flow.
units.failure: 突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。未校正外部雨水便比較兩次蓄水，會把不同環境條件誤當面板性能改變。~An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. Comparing impoundments without rainfall correction confuses environmental differences with changes in face performance.
units.misconception: 排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。~Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation.
units.practice: 以漏流與水量閉合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for leakage and water-balance closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources. Compare joint events with leakage lag and test closure residuals against measurement uncertainty.

units.anchor: 長期蠕變與變形預留~Long-term creep and movement allowance
units.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留~Long-term creep and movement allowance
units.mechanism: 堆石長期變形受到應力、含水與顆粒破碎影響，常用對數時間關係只是經驗描述。短期壓實完成不表示服役期變形停止，接縫預留需檢查情境。 假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。~Long-term rockfill deformation depends on stress, moisture and breakage. Log-time relations are empirical descriptions; completed compaction does not end service movement, so joint allowance must be checked across scenarios. Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Increment is 11.513 mm, a stable-stress fit not extrapolated to failure. A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Increment is 11.513 mm, a stable-stress fit not extrapolated to failure.
units.verify: 使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。檢查新增載重後是否應重新定義時間起點。~Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes. Check whether a new load requires redefining the empirical time origin.
units.failure: 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。~A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty.
units.misconception: 壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。~Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep.
units.practice: 以長期蠕變與變形預留編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for long-term creep and movement allowance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes.
